programme.title: Icon
programme.desc: A former US Operative, who lived in Russia in his earlier years and had been married there with a child, comes out of retirement to face down a former enemy, now running as a candidate for President in modern Russia. Working with a Russian policewoman, they work to uncover a plot to use biological weapons against certain factions of the Russian people to commit genocide. The virus would also be released in other populations, but would be treated making the candidate a hero. A side plot has the agent being reunited with his long lost daughter.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same "street" family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: Son of Dragon is a two-part mini series that retells the Arabian Night's story of "The Thief of Bagdad" setting it in ancient China. The story follows a young man, Devil Boy, who was abandoned at birth. He grows up to become a thief to provide for street children he considers family. Together with his faithful friend and teacher, Bird, he has a plan to rob the royal court of Shanghai. But there he falls in love with the daughter of the Governor, Princess Li Wei. To win over her hand he has to compete against other potential suitors in various challenges set by by the Governor.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 2: Snapshot
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey's latest case has her trying to figure out who killed her best friend Barbara after she was left out of her family's will and every one of the family members become suspects.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 3: Sing Me A Murder
programme.desc: Murder is something to sing about when Mystery Woman Samantha Kinsey-an expert in pulp fiction, and increasingly proficient when it comes to real-life crime-untangles a record-breaking murder. Mystery Woman bookshop owner, Samantha Kinsey, has offered to host a charity concert for a once-famous folk-rock trio out to recapture their old fame flame. But sweet success hits the ultimate sour note when the band's promoter is found murdered in his hotel room. Sam and her partner in crime, Philby, investigate, digging up deadly secrets of private indiscretions, professional greed, and personal vengeance that put a twisted spin on fame and fortune-and bring a whole new meaning to a Top Ten hit.

programme.title: The Roman Spring of Mrs. Stone
Meteor
programme.desc: Meteor is a disaster mini-series about a meteor on a collision course with Earth. After NASA discovers a giant meteor named Kassandra that threatens to erase humanity of the planet, astronomer Dr. Lehman and his assistant Imogene O'Neil must hurry to collect information about it. Lehman tragically dies along the way. Meanwhile, meteor showers are occurring worldwide causing panic. One of the towns hit by the meteorites is Taft in California. There, detective Jack Crowe is tries to find his ex partner Stark before he kills his daughter and father who is the sheriff of the town.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Vimbldonas. Official Film
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Fenerbahce - "Bayern"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Snakes in the City: Uncharted Compilation
programme.desc: Simon and Sioux are on a mission to rescue India's "big four" deadliest snakes for the first time in their careers. Simon strokes the head of a deadly spectacled cobra for the first time on camera. A Russel's viper hides in the heart of a bustling city park. programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: From the wetlands of Rio Grande to the mighty Amazon rainforest, Brazil is a hotspot for deadly snakes and Nigel is seeking them out as he counts down his top ten. Found only on the tiny 'Snake Island', there's only a few hundred Golden Lanceheads in the world. But can they beat the snake responsible for many human bites, the jararaca, to the top spot? With over 25,000 reported bites across the country each year, Nigel delves into the fascinating science behind the anti-venom treatments that save thousands of lives.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Mexico is home to an incredible 400 snake species, nearly a fifth of which are venomous. Nigel searches high and low for his top ten, from ancient oak and pine forests to the towering cacti of the baking hot Mexican desert. Rattlesnakes dominate the landscape, but the widely feared terciopelo and the beautiful Taylor's Cantil are also in the running for number one spot. It's not just snakes that bite here - Nigel has a painful encounter with a lizard with jaws like a vice.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Wild Mongolia: Land of Extremes
programme.desc: Landlocked and bordering both China and Russia, Mongolia is a land of extreme habitats. From the challenging environment of the Gobi desert situated on a mounain plateau to the vast grasslands of the Mongolian Steppe, from the Altai mountains to the Taiga forest in the north of the country, this land is home to some of the hardiest and most resilient animals on the planet. The show explores the topography these distinct environments and chronicles how the wildlife has evolved and adapted so that they can either live with littel access to water or else become totally dependent on grass for their survival.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Jaguars vs. Crocs
programme.desc: Veteran wildlife photographer Steve Winter and cameraman Bertie Gregory capture the remarkable lives of Jaguars in the Pantanal of Brazil. A mother jaguar teaches her cub survival while a determined male jaguar named Scarface dives headfirst into the river to tackle the deadliest of opponents - 6-foot long caiman. Clever capybaras and playful giant otters stick with their family members to avoid being jaguar dinner.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: At Critter Fixers, the docs make sure all their patients are feline their best. Alfred the cat has allergies, and a cat named Loki has a tail injury. A severely dehydrated stray with feline leukemia steals hearts at the clinic, while another former stray needs eye surgery. programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: When Predators Attack
programme.desc: This docuseries detais what happens when predators come face to face with their prey and humans and reveals the reasons why dangerous encounters take place and the best way for people to avoid them or to make a quick escape if necessary. Each one hour long episode focuses on a specifice animal including formidable killer snakes that use deadly venom or constriction to defeat their opponent; black bears, grizzlies, and giant polar bears who are increasingly encroaching into human territory because of climate change and are confronting more humans; and the most ancient of predators, the crocodile.

programme.title: Legends of Venom
programme.desc: Vipers are one of the most feared snake families in the world. Now their stories reveal just how troubled life can be for hated snakes. Rattlesnakes in the desert cheat death by predators and people. Puffadders clean up vermin, yet face persecution. And gaboon vipers on the forest floor dare not move. This is an intimate look at their challenges and how they overcome each with unique superpowers.

programme.title: Legends of Venom
programme.desc: Charmed by some, feared by most - the cobra family is powerful and iconic. From giant cannibalistic king cobras in India, to desert specialists that hunt birds in the Kalahari and semi aquatic Forest cobras stalking toads in African swamps, each one has a unique story and set of challenges to overcome.

programme.title: Python Invasion
programme.desc: Scientists and hunters team up to fight one of the biggest ecological threats to the Florida Everglades: the Burmese python. In the 1990s, pet pythons were released into the wild and have eaten their way through the food chain. Today, nobody knows how many there are, but estimates may be in the hundreds of thousands. We follow the scientists as they track, gather data, and try to understand better how Pythons reproduce and adapt in the Everglades. Ian Bartoszerk and his team at the Conservancy of Southwest Florida use male scout snakes to lead them to females with the potential to lay up to eighty eggs at a time. At the U.S.G.S., Amy Yackle and Mark Sandfoss work in tandem with wildlife biologists from the National Park Service and the University of Florida to battle female reproduction on another front — Alligator Alley.

programme.title: Dragons Uncovered
programme.desc: The Komodo Dragon has captured our imaginations for over a century, yet so much about this incredible lizard remains a mystery. A creature with survival skills and physical characteristics seen in apex predators across the animal kingdom, and the ability to take down predators ten times its size. The secrets of the Komodo Dragon are revealed.

programme.title: Wild Hunters
programme.desc: Despite their ancient appearance, reptiles are creatures full of surprises and sophistication. Much like dinosaurs, reptiles are hugely efficient hunters.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: She haunts the trees and hills in the heart of the realm. She is solitary, silent and virtually invisible. Saba the leopard is a killer without rival. Saba is the most spectacular and resourceful hunter the Savage Kingdom has seen. Her stronghold, Leopard Rock, sits at the heart of this brutal realm it is a place where she can vanish into the shadows and avoid running into her rivals lions, hyenas and wild dogs. There is no question that Saba the leopard can take care of herself, but her strength and resilience will be cruelly tested when she tries to bring two cubs into the realm where only she can protect and feed them in the midst of the cauldron of warring predators. The ordeal will tear at her heart.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The Docs at Critter Fixer wrangle some rambunctious sugar gliders, treat a dog with severe smoke inhalation and inspect piglets who might have mites. The Docs check out a couple of rabbits who are all ears, tend to a ferret's tail, treat a family cat with a hernia, and get up close with a gator. programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: The Schroeders solve a slate of mysterious cases: Dr. Erin gets to the bottom of a cat's laboured breathing while Dr. Ben provides relief for a flock of featherless chickens and a bull with a bum hoof. A bald eagle is rushed in with a life-threatening wound before the vets join forces to remove a Pitbull's cancerous lump. Between cases, the docs motivate each other to shed a few unwanted pounds.

programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.desc: Henry Fonda e Claudia Cardinale nel western che ha consacrato il mito di Sergio Leone. Un magnate delle ferrovie ingaggia un killer per impadronirsi del terreno di un'ex prostituta.

programme.title: Dogman (2018)
programme.desc: Marcello Fonte, premiato a Cannes, ed Edoardo Pesce nel film di Matteo Garrone ispirato a un fatto di cronaca. Periferia di Roma: un mite toelettatore reagisce ai soprusi del suo aguzzino.

programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: 6 Oscar al musical di Damien Chazelle con Ryan Gosling ed Emma Stone, premiata a Venezia. Mia, aspirante attrice, s'innamora di Sebastian, pianista jazz che sogna di aprire un night club.

programme.title: Vermiglio
programme.desc: 7 David di Donatello per l'opera di Maura Delpero premiata anche a Venezia. La Seconda guerra mondiale volge al termine quando la stabilità di una famiglia trentina è stravolta.

programme.title: Speciale - Petra Terza Stagione
programme.desc: La terza stagione vede naturalmente protagonista Paola Cortellesi affiancata da Andrea Pennacchi. Entra in scena Francesco Acquaroli nel ruolo di Luigi, un poliziotto esperto e brillante che con Petra ha un legame speciale.

programme.title: First Man - Il primo uomo
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e' Neil Armstrong nel biopic di Damien Chazelle premiato con 1 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe. America, anni 60: la storia della missione spaziale che porto' alla conquista della Luna.

programme.title: Cattive acque
programme.desc: Mark Ruffalo e Anne Hathaway in un dramma legale di impegno civile, tratto da una storia vera e diretto da Todd Haynes. Rischiando in prima persona, un coraggioso avvocato sfida una potente multinazionale accusandola di aver inquinato per anni l’acqua di una zona degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Dogman (2018)
programme.desc: Marcello Fonte, premiato a Cannes, ed Edoardo Pesce nel film di Matteo Garrone ispirato a un fatto di cronaca. Periferia di Roma: un mite toelettatore reagisce ai soprusi del suo aguzzino.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.title: The Apprentice - Alle origini di Trump
programme.desc: Sebastian Stan è l’imprenditore e Presidente USA nel biopic di Ali Abbasi. New York, anni 70: l'ascesa del magnate segnata dall'incontro con l'avvocato Roy Cohn (Jeremy Strong).

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: The Fabelmans
programme.desc: Michelle Williams e Paul Dano nel film piu' intimo e autobiografico di Steven Spielberg. Quando l'armonia della sua famiglia si incrina, Sammy si rifugia nella settima arte.

programme.title: Conclave
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe all'acclamato film di Edward Berger ambientato nel mondo della Chiesa con Ralph Fiennes, Stanley Tucci, Sergio Castellitto e Isabella Rossellini.

programme.title: Pulp fiction
programme.desc: 1 Oscar, 1 Golden Globe e Palma d'oro a Cannes per il film-simbolo di Quentin Tarantino con John Travolta, Uma Thurman e Bruce Willis in un intreccio di scene cult e personaggi stravaganti.

programme.title: Thelma
programme.desc: Una fantastica June Squibb è la trascinatrice di una action-comedy carica di humor. Los Angeles: vittima di una truffa telefonica, l'ostinata e orgogliosa novantatreenne Thelma si arma di coraggio e si avventura alla ricerca del delinquente che le ha estorto il denaro.

programme.title: Changeling
programme.desc: Biopic diretto da Clint Eastwood con Angelina Jolie. Los Angeles, 1928: una donna afferma che il bambino che le hanno riportato dopo un rapimento non è suo figlio, ma nessuno le crede.

programme.title: Spencer
programme.desc: Biopic con Kristen Stewart nei panni della Principessa Diana. Natale 1991: nella tenuta reale di Sandringham, Lady D. matura la decisione di interrompere il matrimonio con Carlo.

programme.title: Pulp fiction
programme.desc: 1 Oscar, 1 Golden Globe e Palma d'oro a Cannes per il film-simbolo di Quentin Tarantino con John Travolta, Uma Thurman e Bruce Willis in un intreccio di scene cult e personaggi stravaganti.

programme.title: Thelma
programme.desc: Una fantastica June Squibb è la trascinatrice di una action-comedy carica di humor. Los Angeles: vittima di una truffa telefonica, l'ostinata e orgogliosa novantatreenne Thelma si arma di coraggio e si avventura alla ricerca del delinquente che le ha estorto il denaro.

programme.title: Conclave
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe all'acclamato film di Edward Berger ambientato nel mondo della Chiesa con Ralph Fiennes, Stanley Tucci, Sergio Castellitto e Isabella Rossellini.

programme.title: Margin Call
programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Paul Bettany e Jeremy Irons in un thriller ambientato a Wall Street. All'alba della crisi finanziaria, un gruppo di manager ha 24 ore per evitare il fallimento di una banca.

programme.title: The Blues Brothers
programme.desc: John Belushi e Dan Aykroyd nell'irriverente commedia musicale di John Landis. Per salvare l'orfanotrofio in cui sono cresciuti, due fratelli riuniscono la loro band per un concerto.

programme.title: L'amore Che Non Muore
programme.desc: Grande successo in Francia per la pellicola di Gilles Lellouche. Una rapina finita male divide le strade di Jacqueline e Clotaire, ma la forza del primo amore resterà intatta...

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: 3 Oscar, 3 Golden Globe e Leone d'argento alla regia di Brady Corbet che dirige Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones e Guy Pearce. Un architetto ebreo e sua moglie, sopravvissuti all'Olocausto, lasciano l'Ungheria per emigrare negli Stati Uniti. Un facoltoso cliente cambierà le loro vite.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: 6 Oscar per il capolavoro di Kathryn Bigelow con Jeremy Renner protagonista. In Iraq, una squadra di artificieri statunitensi viene inviata sul posto per una pericolosa missione.

programme.title: Santa Maradona
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello per l'esordio alla regia di Marco Ponti con Stefano Accorsi, Libero De Rienzo e Anita Caprioli. La vita di Andrea scorre noiosa e piatta finché non incontra Dolores.

programme.title: A beautiful mind
programme.desc: 4 Oscar e 4 Golden Globe per il capolavoro di Ron Howard con Russell Crowe e Jennifer Connelly. L'avvincente biografia di John Nash, genio matematico e premio Nobel affetto da schizofrenia.

programme.title: Cuori ribelli
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Nicole Kidman nel dramma romantico di Ron Howard. Due giovani irlandesi, Shannon e Joseph, si trasferiscono a Boston in cerca di fortuna affrontando mille peripezie.

programme.title: The Blues Brothers
programme.desc: John Belushi e Dan Aykroyd nell'irriverente commedia musicale di John Landis. Per salvare l'orfanotrofio in cui sono cresciuti, due fratelli riuniscono la loro band per un concerto.

programme.title: Il tenente ottomano
programme.desc: L'amore in tempo di guerra in un dramma con Ben Kingsley e Josh Hartnett. Alla vigilia della Grande Guerra, un'infermiera lascia l'America per una missione medica nell'Impero turco.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: 3 Oscar, 3 Golden Globe e Leone d'argento alla regia di Brady Corbet che dirige Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones e Guy Pearce. Un architetto ebreo e sua moglie, sopravvissuti all'Olocausto, lasciano l'Ungheria per emigrare negli Stati Uniti. Un facoltoso cliente cambierà le loro vite.

programme.title: J. Edgar
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: La migliore offerta
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.title: Cuori ribelli
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Nicole Kidman nel dramma romantico di Ron Howard. Due giovani irlandesi, Shannon e Joseph, si trasferiscono a Boston in cerca di fortuna affrontando mille peripezie.

programme.title: Emilia Perez
programme.desc: 2 Oscar, Miglior attrice e Premio della giuria a Cannes per l'originale pellicola di Jacques Audiard con Zoe Saldana, Karla Sofia Gascon, Selena Gomez.

programme.title: Ariaferma
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Silvio Orlando nel dramma carcerario di Leonardo Di Costanzo che indaga il delicato rapporto tra secondini e detenuti, premiato con 2 David di Donatello 2022.

programme.title: Provaci ancora, Sam
programme.desc: Una commedia scritta e interpretata da Woody Allen, con Diane Keaton. Un critico cinematografico, goffo con le donne, chiede aiuto al fantasma di Humphrey Bogart per sedurre la bella Linda.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Gli esperti di Sky Cinema, Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova, analizzano e mettono a confronto due film in programmazione sui canali Sky a puntata, per un confronto ricco di approfondimenti.

programme.title: Ghostbusters - Minaccia glaciale
programme.desc: New York: L'apertura di un antico e misterioso manufatto risveglia dal sonno eterno un esercito di demoni malvagi e la Terra rischia una nuova era glaciale. Vecchi e nuovi ghostbusters si uniscono per evitare l'Apocalisse.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sui film della serie Ghostbusters.

programme.title: Ghostbusters - Acchiappafantasmi
programme.desc: Cult assoluto della commedia anni 80 con Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd e Harold Ramis. New York: tre scienziati fondano un'agenzia che si occupa di catturare fantasmi e sfidano il demone Zuul.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd e Sigourney Weaver nel sequel della commedia cult anni 80. Gli Acchiappafantasmi affrontano una forza maligna che ha invaso i sotterranei di New York.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Legacy
programme.desc: Jason Reitman dirige il nuovo atteso capitolo della saga cult. Mentre la terra trema misteriosamente, due ragazzi scoprono i segreti del defunto nonno, l'acchiappafantasmi Egon Spengler.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Reboot al femminile del cult anni 80 con Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig e Chris Hemsworth. Sfidando lo scetticismo degli accademici, quattro donne formano un team di acchiappafantasmi.

programme.title: Pil's Adventures - Un regno da salvare
programme.desc: Animazione targata Sky Original ambientata nel Medioevo. L'orfanella Pil vive ai margini del regno. Quando pero' il trono viene usurpato, tocca a lei aiutare il legittimo erede.

programme.title: 100% Lupo
programme.desc: Avventura d'animazione tratta da un libro per ragazzi. Freddy Lupin, discendente di una stirpe di fieri lupi mannari, si trasforma misteriosamente in un tenero barboncino.

programme.title: I Croods 2 - Una nuova era
programme.desc: Seconda avventura animata per gli sprizzanti cavernicoli. Dopo aver accolto il giovane Guy, i Croods vanno in cerca di un luogo chiamato ‘casa’. Una volta trovato, dovranno fare i conti con i suoi abitanti, l'evoluto clan dei Superior, finché una nuova minaccia non porterà le due famiglie a unire le loro forze.

programme.title: Me contro Te: Il film - Missione Giungla

Extreme Ends
programme.desc: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

programme.title: Elimination Game
programme.desc: Navy SEAL Rick is sentenced to rot in a military prison until he is offered the opportunity to put his life on the line and win his freedom in a kill or be killed reality show. Rick will have to eliminate some of the world's most notorious killers on live TV to gain his freedom and clear his name. Can he succeed finally?

programme.title: 10 Fight 10 Season 3
programme.desc: The show brings Thai superstars, singers, boxers, models and rappers into the celebrity boxing ring. Season 2 features a first ever Thai female match and Season 3 has two Olympics gold medalists competing for the championship. This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle….

With Mike on the run, Jimmy's only penance for his past mistakes may be to keep his son from the same fate Jimmy is certain he'll face himself...at the wrong end of a gun. Now, with nowhere safe to turn, Jimmy just has one night to figure out exactly where his loyalties lie and to see if he can finally make things right.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai. DiCaprio stars as Danny Archer, a mercenary smuggler searching for a priceless diamond amid the chaos of Sierra Leone's civil war; Hounsou (Gladiator), as a desperate father searching for his lost son; and Connelly (A Beautiful Mind), as a reporter searching for the truth behind the trade in 'conflict diamonds.' Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.

programme.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
programme.desc: Stone Age Earth: In the presence of a mysterious black obelisk, pre-humans discover the use of tools--and weapons--violently taking first steps toward intelligence. 1999: On Earth's moon astronauts uncover another mysterious black obelisk. 2001: Between Earth and Jupiter, the spacecraft's intelligent computer makes a mistake that kills most of the human crew--then continues to kill to hide its error. Beyond Time: The sole survivor of the journey to Jupiter ascends to the next level of humanity.

programme.title: The Wrong Man
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Henry Fonda stars in director Alfred Hitchcock's real-life thriller of an innocent man trapped as the victim of a heartless criminal justice system--even though he's The Wrong Man. When an eyewitness to a robbery identifies musician Christopher Balestrero (Fonda) as the culprit, Balestrero cannot prove where he was on the day of the crime. Now, the wheels of justice--driven by the testimony of witnesses--mercilessly grind away the life of a man who looks remarkably like the real thief. Based on the novel The True Story of Christopher Emmanuel Balestrero by Maxwell Anderson.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Courtney Collins, a single mother, relocates to a rural home with her twin sons. Later, she discovers it's inhabited by malevolent spirits connected to the sinister entity Bughuul.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: Imprisoned at the International Space Station, a group of terrorists manage to escape confinement and take control of the ship. However, their mission to target the Soviets threatens world peace.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: John Wharton, the captain of an elite task force, raids a safe house owned by one of the most lethal drug cartels with his team. Though the mission is successful, death awaits them.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: James Bond reaches the North Korean military base and finds out the presence of a corrupt colonel. However, his identity is revealed, and he strives to escape and reprimand the criminals.

programme.title: Piranha 3D
programme.desc: An earthquake cracks open the bottom of a lake, releasing a prehistoric species of piranha. As sinister events unfold due to the flesh-eating fish, a group of strangers team up to stop the bloodbath.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: John, son of Sarah Connor, sends a reprogrammed Terminator to protect his younger self, who also holds the key to humanity's survival, from the T-1000, an advanced robot created by Skynet.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Upon getting adopted by the Littles, Stuart, a mouse, is unwelcomed by his new brother George. So, when Stuart begins to feel low the family helps him find his real parents.

programme.title: Johnny English
programme.desc: Johnny English, a bumbling British agent, teams up with an Interpol agent and attempts to locate a French billionaire who has stolen the crown jewels.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat
programme.desc: To protect Earth from the Outworld, MMA fighter Cole Young sets out to find a group of fighters to defend the planet in a critical tournament.

programme.title: Wonder Woman 1984
programme.desc: Wonder Woman battles Maxwell Lorenzano, an evil businessman, and Barbara Minerva, her friend-turned-foe, who wreak havoc on the world through a wish-granting artefact.

programme.title: Vehicle 19
programme.desc: Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.

programme.title: Vehicle 19
programme.desc: Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: After being diagnosed with a terminal illness, spy Ethan Renner decides to give up his career. While looking after his teenage daughter, he must finish his final mission of catching a terrorist.

programme.title: Stars!
programme.desc: The host sheds light on various popular individuals from different walks of life and highlights their individual journeys to stardom.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas, a young man, trains under an elder in order to become the keeper of his community's memories. However, things get complicated once he discovers the sinister side of his city.

programme.title: StreetDance 2
programme.desc: After an embaressing defeat, a street dancer, Ash, assembles the best dancers from all across the world for another around against the Invincible crew.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: After putting an end to the dystopian Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and her friends attempt to rescue a brainwashed companion and free their nation from the control of President Coriolanus Snow.

programme.title: Inescapable
programme.desc: Adib, settled in Canada, confronts his mysterious past in Damascus when his daughter vanishes there, forcing him to return.
